verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is a banking-as-a-service API that handles sensitive customer and financial data, so whether that data can be excluded from AI model training is a fair privacy question for this kind of product. The evidence pack covers sandbox access, API keys, account opening, KYC, payments, cards and webhooks, but says nothing about AI training data use, opt-outs, or data-usage policies.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
